rules.title: No cure or treatment claims
rules.description: Do not claim that products cure, treat, or heal acne or any skin condition.

rules.title: Disclose paid promotion
rules.description: Paid promotional content must include #ad or #sponsored.

rules.title: Use approved product facts
rules.description: Product claims must be supported by approved brand facts; unverified numerical or time-based claims must be flagged for review.

rules.title: Avoid pressure tactics
rules.description: Use informative, respectful wording. Avoid pressure tactics such as buy now, last chance, only today, or hurry.

rules.title: No guaranteed results
rules.description: Do not guarantee results or promise a specific outcome.

rules.title: No competitor disparagement
rules.description: Do not disparage competitors by name.

rules.title: Avoid immediate-result promises
rules.description: Do not promise overnight or immediate product results.

rules.title: Disclose paid partnerships
rules.description: Paid partnership content must include #ad or #sponsored.

rules.title: Use approved product wording
rules.description: The approved product fact is fragrance-free moisturizer. Other factual claims should be verified before approval.
